COMMERCIAL LINES MANUAL EXCEPTION 
CALIFORNIA 
THE INSURANCE SERVICES OFFICE COMMERCIAL LINES MANUAL APPLIES EXCEPT AS 
MODIFIED BELOW: 
DIVISION FIVE 
FIRE AND ALLIED LINES 
 
LOSS COST MULTIPLIER 
 
All Loss Costs shall be adjusted by the applicable Loss Cost Multiplier.  
 
The Loss Cost Multiplier shall apply before all applicable manual factors such as the coinsurance credit, 
the deductible, and the package credit factor.  This multiplier shall apply only to Loss Costs, not to rates, 
premiums, or minimum premium charges. 
 
The Loss Costs applicable to this division shall be multiplied by the following Loss Cost Multiplier:  
 
Coverage Loss Cost Multiplier 
All applicable coverage 2.198 
 
NOTE:  Before applying multiplier, make sure the coverage being rated is based on Loss Costs and not 
rates or premiums.  Do not apply multiplier to any coverage that shows rates or premiums (i.e. Equipment 
Breakdown, Water Damage, etc.). 
 
The loss costs, premiums and additional charges applicable to this division shall apply.
